name: Mouse Battery
author: Daniel Donaldson
description: Battery level of connected wireless mice, read live from UPower. Hidden when no mouse is connected.

barWidget.description: Battery percentage of connected wireless mice

schema.label: Show percentage
schema.description: Off shows just the icon; the level stays in the tooltip.

schema.label: Low battery threshold (%)
schema.description: At or below this the widget turns the urgent colour.
